sd_card_detect_irq_diagnostic_0109.limitation: 30s bounded masking of only GPIO38 card-detect. Data IRQ unchanged. No FPS gain; restored, module removed.

atomic_pipeline_0109.evidence: Single CRTC, unique active flushed atomic tail at presentation; not optical timing.
atomic_pipeline_0109.limitation: Initial modesets are included. Fence waits include scheduling and are not CPU execution or pure GPU execution.

gui_validation.limitation: Sequential short runs; CPU improvement does not establish FPS gain. First candidate recording invalidated by in-place profiler update; valid repeat retained. Ordinary system Mesa restored.

texture_upload_boxes_0110.limitation: Bounded GL interposer adds logging outside timed upload calls. Single-context/unit texture tracking.

gui_validation.limitation: Short sequential samples. CPU stalls removed; GPU work still exceeds a refresh.

live_comparison.limitation: Different session scenes prevent attributing FPS difference to the upload path.

cpu_tiled_upload_corrected_0110.layout: TILE_4X4=1; observed read-only physical offsets at 32x32 and 63x47
cpu_tiled_upload_corrected_0110.limitation: Short diagnostic runs, not general stability or physical image acceptance. Same-process test controls scene changes; separate earlier sessions did not.

liftoff_backend_0110.limitation: Switching backend alone does not supply output layers. Startup includes commit EBUSY errors; zero underruns applies only to bounded measurement.

primary_reuse_same_process_ABA.control: Only primary reuse toggled; same compositor, libraries, native planes and animation actions.

native_output_composition_0111.residual_change: A full-screen top-panel-background root changes global alpha during the drawer motion. Logs show unchanged visual sequence and changing alpha, so blindly reusing its composite would be incorrect.
native_output_composition_0111.limitation: DRM presentation bursts, not optical FPS. Private prototypes retain ordinary rendering fallback and restore the system session. Best aggregate 50.065 FPS; stable 60 FPS is not achieved.

native_kms_texture_sources_0111.source: CPU-written native msm-kms dumb BO exported to the GPU as DMA-BUF, synchronized with DMA_BUF_IOCTL_SYNC and reattached as EGLImage

native_output_crc_0111.result: All tested grouped output signatures match ordinary texture composition exactly, including fractional alpha. Direct single-plane fractional-alpha signature differs; cause unresolved.

cpu_frame_preparation_0111.timestamp_limitation: Original perf default clock and GLib monotonic timestamps are not directly aligned. Do not add cross-clock event offsets. New recordings explicitly select CLOCK_MONOTONIC.

includes: SHM writes only after buffer release
snapshot_damage_validation_0111.limitations: Test helper exited before FPS recording; all CRC cases completed. Owner reported broken image during the diagnostic-pattern period. Actual physical corruption versus test pattern is unresolved. Ordinary session restored and ordinary benchmark completed.

snapshot_damage_speed_attempt_0111.cause: Pre-recording screenshot attempted a user write into root-owned /run/t531-planes; permission denied. Automatic ordinary-session restoration completed.

snapshot_damage_speed_0111.conclusion: Partial snapshot copies execute and reduce CPU preparation. No material aggregate FPS gain over the previous 50.413 FPS trial; this is not a same-process ABA control.

gtk_cpu_frame_timing_0111.probe: tools/gtk-frame-probe.c; CPU-only GDK before-paint to after-paint signals, no breakpoints
gtk_cpu_frame_timing_0111.limitation: DRM presentation rate is not the count of distinct GUI content updates. Slow GTK frames individually exceed the refresh period before GPU composition.

gui_cpu_sampling_0111.stack_limitation: Only leaf frames are reliable in this ARM trace; debug symbol lookup resolves function names. Do not invent callers from the sampled stack.

pixman_in_reverse_candidate.limitation: Initial microbenchmark is not GUI FPS; GUI testing is pending. Whole private build compiler settings may affect other functions; compare identical private DSO with only the combiner selector changed.

cpu_clock_pmu_extended.workload: Native CPU-only combiner checks/benchmark, pinned to each core in turn; no PLL/MMIO changes.
cpu_clock_pmu_extended.conclusion: No low actual CPU clock observed on these two cores during this workload. Does not verify every core/idle transition.

pixman_controlled_gui_0111.control: Same private library/compiler settings, startup selector switches IN_REVERSE only; separate sessions, not same-process ABA.
pixman_controlled_gui_0111.limitation: Small gain; CPU-heavy GTK frames still exceed16.7ms. Do not claim60 distinct GUI frames or general app acceptance.

pixman_public_call_timing_0111.probe: tools/pixman-call-probe.c; bounded public API CPU timing
pixman_public_call_timing_0111.limitation: Bounded slow calls only; not a complete work distribution or an accepted uninstrumented FPS benchmark.

pixman_solid_fast_path_0111.control_details: Identical library; only solid fast-path entries are skipped by a private startup selector. General NEON IN_REVERSE remains enabled in both.
pixman_solid_fast_path_0111.conclusion: Exact pixels and a small CPU reduction, but no aggregate FPS gain. Keep isolated, not a production60FPS claim.

cpu_cache_state_0111.limitation: Control bits and geometry alone are not a cache-function or power-transition test.

limitations: Dependent cache-line loads, not sequential bandwidth or GUI frame time.
Ordinary Phosh remains running; shared-L2 contention, TLB misses and loop overhead contribute.
Not an L2 frequency measurement or validation of all power transitions.

pixman_production_build_0111.limitation: The clean build passes correctness; GUI FPS was measured with the separate controlled private DSO.

fold_clear_logged_aba_0111.conclusion: Confirmed execution, no measurable gain; disabled.

limitations: Three repeated hardware DSI signatures per reference, not optical acceptance.
Specific one-LSB difference does not establish the hardware blend equation or all alpha cases.

apcs_hardware_clock_0111.method: KPSS GLB_CLK_DIAG, divider4, GCC debug selector362, XO/4 hardware counter; restore all diagnostic registers
apcs_hardware_clock_0111.limitation: CPU-bound workload on CPU1 then CPU3, ordinary GUI active; not all idle/suspend states.
